Explore Sanjauli.

Twenty story missions begin at the Chowki and lead through Sanjauli, IGMC and the fictional depot. Use the Case File (M) to review evidence. Press R to retry the current checkpoint. Press T to interact. A full day passes automatically in 18 real minutes. Explore the showrooms near Dhalli Tunnel and look uphill for Dhingu Mata Mandir when you turn right at Chowk. NPCs chat, and may chase you if you shove them. J punches/slaps; G swings your danda; hold K to block. Repeated shoving, fights and dangerous driving bring police. Run out of sight to lose them, or press L near police to surrender. If caught, you go to Sanjauli Chowki and are released after a short custody scene.
